sanskrit: sarvakālakramārthajñaṃ praṇamyājaṃ śivaṃ dhruvamvakṣyamāṇena saṃbandhaḥvacmi sādhakabodhāya leśato yuktisaṃskṛtaurauravānusāreṇaiva saṃkṣepād vadāmikarmāśayānurūpeṇa cidvatāṃ bhavamaṇḍaleśrīmatsvāyaṃbhuve- yadyaśuddhirna puṃso'sti saktirbhogeṣu kiṃ kṛtā itisādhanaiḥ sādhyate bhogo buddhivṛttyanurañjanaḥvedanā pusaḥ sukhaduḥkhādilakṣaṇā itisvamātrāpūrapuṣṭānāṃ gamayanti tadaṅgatāmyataḥvyūho'vakāśadānaṃ ca vṛttayo vasudhādiṣupāko'gneḥ | vyūho'vayavaghaṭanaṃ vāyoḥ | avakāśasyāspadasya dānamākāśasyayoneryonyantaraṃ cāpi yāti puṃbhogasiddhayekālānto'yam | karmavaśato bhuvanajadeheṣvayaṃ ca sarveṣu || (ślo0 24-25) itiakṣādhāro'kṣagamyo'yamanīśānāṃ piśācavatśuklādi śuklaṃ bhāsvacca rūpaṃ kṣityādiṣu triṣujale śītaḥ śikhinyuṣṇasparśo'yaṃ saṃvyavasthitaḥpratiśabdakasaṃghāto nabhasyevodito budhaiḥmātrāstairanumānataḥkramavyaṅgyā yathā citraṃ paṭe rūpaṃ tu veṣṭitekramavyaṅgyatvato hetorgocaratvaṃ vrajantyamīviṣayatāṃ prāpnuvantidharitryāṃ hi jalādīnāmagrahe'pi prajāyatejalādiṣvevamevāyaṃ yojyo heturmanīṣibhiḥtasmādasiddhatā nāsti hetorupahite maṇau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guṇagrahaṇapūrvakatvaṃ siddhameva | ato'sya hetornāsiddhatetikṣityādikakalāntānāṃ yojyaḥ kāraṇasiddhayepratipuruṣaniyatatvenācaitanye satyanekatvāt kāraṇapūrvakatvaṃ siddhyatītiyonayo gaganādīnāṃ kramamicchanti dharmiṇāmkurvantītyarthaḥmātrādyāsu pumarthasya sādhanatvaṃ viniścitamtadāpūrakatayā ca bhogatvaṃ siddhamupasthapādapāyvāsyapāṇināmāni vai pṛthaksthāneṣu satsu tānīha pañca karmendriyāṇi tunecchanti naiyāyikādayaste pratikṣiptāḥkarmendriyāṇyato naiṣāmānantyaṃ karmaṇāṃ vaśātviśeṣādhiṣṭhānādityavirodhaḥna caikakaraṇā yasmādapekṣā na nivartatedṛśyata iti bhāvaḥśabdādyālocanaṃ teṣāṃ vṛttiḥ śabdādisannidhaudraṣṭavyā |) buddhyā'dhvavasitamarthaṃ puruṣaścetayate itisthāneṣu satsu vaikalyānna saṃvijjñāyate yataḥtatsiddhau karaṇānyantarmano'haṅkārabuddhayaḥprapañcayiṣyateśibikodvāhinaravadekāpāyena tāstataḥbāhyārthaṃ buddhibhiḥ sārdhaṃ na syuricchādikāḥ kriyāḥprayatnairna vinā so'sti tatsiddhau karaṇaṃ tu kimsaṃrambho'haṅkṛtervṛttiḥ (ślo0 33) itivyaktaṃ na cāsya caitanyaṃ vāyutvād bāhyavāyuvatcaitanyaṃ vāyutvād bāhyavāyuvaditi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mano yasyāśubhāvācca karturna yugapanmatiḥata eva etadāśu saṃcārītyuktamanyo'rthapratyayo'paraḥahaṅkāravṛttyātmakapratyayo'rthapratyayādanya ityarthaḥyato'nyatamavaikalye jāyate satyahaṅkṛtiḥjāyamāno'yaṃ saṃrambho'haṃpratyayo vāhaṅkārasyaiva kārya ityarthaḥtaijasādikanāmānaḥ kramaśaḥ sāttvikādayaḥsattvādiguṇabāhulyāttasmāt sa sāttvikājjātaḥ svānurūpādahaṅkṛtaḥviṣayāṇāṃ tu niyamādasiddhādeva hetutaḥgṛhyantedravyāṇyaniyataṃ caiva gṛhṇāti marutā samamtadgatāṃśca sparśān gṛhṇātiato na niyamo'kṣāṇāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ ca kalpyatedevebhyo buddhayo na syuḥ samavāye ca dehināmpadārthānāṃ buddhayastebhyo jāyamānā na bhaveyuḥpumarthadātṛ yatkarma kāraṇaṃ tad bhaveritamcetyarthaḥśabdabhogasya niyame tatpradaṃ karma bhāṣitamkarmaiva kāraṇaṃ bhavatā'pīṣyata ityanvayaḥjātaḥ kāryasya yeneha kāraṇānuvidhāyitākarmendriyavargo jātaḥ | yasmāt kāraṇānuvidhāyitvaṃ kārye dṛśyatesāttvikāt saṃbhave kḷpte sāttvarājasavargayoḥprakāśyastāmasastasmājjāto bhūtādisaṃjñakātpuṃbodhavyaktibhūmitvād bodho vṛttirmatermatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bodhavyaktibhūmitayā paśoḥ || (vi0 11|8) itiicchāsaṃrambhabodhākhyāstenāntaḥkaraṇa tridhāvṛttayo bhinnārthatvād bhinnakāraṇā iti bhāvaḥbuddhiścāpi hyasaṃvedyā dhanyā tārkikatā tavaviṣayādhyavasāyahetutvāt siddhamityuktambhogyaṃ vinā na bhogo'stītyato bhogasya sādhanamsukhādyadhyavasāyasyāpi sādhanamiṣyateprayuṅkte mahadādīni bodhādyarthamaṇustathābuddhyādisaṃsthe bodhādau puṃsaḥ kartṛtvamiṣyatesādhanaṃ vijayasyeṣṭāstathaiva mahadādayaḥtato bodhādivṛttīnāṃ sādhanaṃ mahadādayaḥbauddho bodhaḥ paraṃ bhogyaṃ māyādi ca tadarthataḥtvāt paramparayā bhogyamititamorajaḥsattvamayaṃ rūpaṃ tatkarmajaṃ mataupaṭādibodhāvaitatyādātmano na guṇā guṇāḥprākṛto dehasaṃyoge vyaktaḥ svapnādibodhavat | (vi0 10|26-29) itisvargo muktiḥ prakṛtibhāvo vighātaśca phalāni cavaśyordhvasthitiḥ saddṛṣṭibhṛttvaṃ bhogāspṛhā phalamvinayaprākṛte rūpe pūrvoktaphalasaṃgrahaḥrāgamātrānuliptāṅgād dharmādisamudāyataḥtuṣṭiḥ kṛtārthavijñānamanayā''tmagrahe satikṛtārtho'smīti yā matiḥ (mṛ0 vi0 11|2) itiaśaktirdevavaikalyādasāmarthyaṃ śubhādiṣu| rājasyapi guṇo dṛṣṭaḥ kārye kāraṇasaṃśrayaḥ || (mṛ0 vi0 11|6) itiīṣad dharmādisaṃpṛktādabhivyakto viparyayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kiñcitsāmānyato'nyatra matiranyā viparyayaḥ (mṛ0 vi0 11|3) itibhogyatvaṃ cāsya saṃsiddhaṃ yenotpanno'nubhūyatesarvadā grāhakarūpeṇa sthirasyaiva svasaṃvedanasiddhatvādityuktamsādhayitrā vinā yasmāt siddhirneha samīhitātatkartṛtvenāpyātmasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | samīhitā, abhīṣṭetyarthaḥdṛṣṭasya kena saṃvādo yena tasyāsti mānatāśrīmanmataṅgavṛttyādāvācāryaiḥ sādhitamitianvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vyabhicāranirākṛtiḥkartṛpūrvakatvadarśanād bhogakriyayā bhoktā'numīyateasmāt sāmānyato dṛṣṭādanyasyāpi pramāṇatācetano buddhibodhasya bhoktā mānasamarthitaḥcaitanyaṃ hi tvayā tasya kena mānena niścitamanabhivyaktacaitanyā dṛṣṭā bhogyā guḍādayaḥnirākṛto'yaṃ pakṣo'smābhiḥ śrīmanmṛgendravṛttidīpikāyāmbhogyatvakaraṇatvābhyāmindriyāṇāṃ viniścitamnāma kārakaḥ || itibhokturbhogaścitervyaktirbhogyacchāyānurañjitāsukhaduḥ?khādilakṣaṇā itibhogyadvāreṇa pāśānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca parasparam| tadvivekajñāne tu teṣāṃ prakṛtilaya ityuktam | sa eva ca sāṃkhyānāṃ mokṣaḥbhogye bhogaḥ prabhośchāyā yathā candramaso jalepuruṣasyaiva kartṛtvaṃ nācetanānāṃ bhogyānāṃ buddhyādīnāmiti mantavyamaviśeṣo durāpohaḥ prasakto bhoktṛmuktayoḥubhayorapyanapekṣatvena tulyatvātbhoktaryavikṛte bhogo muktavannopapadyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samalatvasarāgatādyabhyupagantavyamiti vakṣyāmaḥsvarūpavyaktilābhācca na vikāro na nāśitāśivaśaktyā sarvaviṣayo'bhivyajyate | tato nāsya vikāro vināśitā cetiśarīrapariṇāmena pariṇāmī na pudgalaḥcaitanyaṃ hi guṇo jñānaṃ samavāyo'tha tena vātadayuktam, jaḍatve tasya ghaṭādivajjñānasamavāyāyogāditiajñe naryeva vijñānaṃ nānyatreti niyāmakammoho mohasvabhāvebhyo yadvannārthāntaraṃ budhāḥprayoktṛkaraṇaṃ bhogye rañjakaṃ copari trayambuddheḥ skandho'paro bhinno yo'haṅkāramajījanatpadārtheṣu vartante | sāttvikādivyavahārastu teṣāṃ sattvādibāhulyāditi bhāvaḥprathamā vikṛtiḥ sā'to guṇānāṃ tatra yujyateahaṅkāre'pyayaṃ nyāya iti mā jalpa paṇḍitaguṇebhya evotpattirityadoṣaḥsattvaṃ rajastamaśceti kāraṇāni dhiyo guṇāḥśauryakrauryādīnāmaratimāndyādīnāṃ guṇakāryāṇāmāgameṣu śravaṇātacaitanye'pyanekatvasaṃkhyāsaṃbandhahetutaḥghaṭādivat kāryatvasiddhiḥupādānaṃ guṇānāṃ yat prakṛtiḥ sābhidhīyatebhogyānubhavamāsādya bhogye saktiḥ pravartatesidhyarthaṃ bhogābhilāṣajanako rāgo'bhyupagantavyaḥsattvaṃ rajastamato yuktaṃ viṣayeṣvanurañjakamtanmatāvuditaṃ bhogyaṃ tasmin yo'syānurañjakaḥanekatattvaparikalpanābhāvaprasaṅgāccakaraṇaṃ na vinā kartuḥ kṛtiḥ karmaṇi dṛśyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pradīpavanmatistasya svaparātmaprakāśikākaraṇāntarasiddhiḥpradīpaḥ karaṇaṃ puṃsaḥ stambhādyarthopalabdhiṣukaraṇāntarasāpekṣaḥ sakto grāhayitumātmānam || (ślo0 14) ititraiguṇyāt sā vivekena śaktā darśayituṃ nahividyā guṇaparā vedyaṃ viviktā'to vivekataḥkarmādikārakānīkaprayoktā bhogasiddhayeśāstreṣūcyateakartṛtvā'bhyupagame bhoktṛśabdo nirarthakaḥkaraṇādisaṃbandhasya nirarthakatvātkartṛmat karmadevādi kriyāsādhanabhāvataḥbhogakriyāvidhau jantornijaguḥ kartṛkārakam || (vi0 10|7) itivyaktikartranapekṣasya kartṛbhāve samīhitesarvakartṛtvasaṃbandhāt sarvajñaḥ parameśavatna cāsya sarvakartṛtvaṃ baddhatvād govṛṣādivatskandho'paraḥ kalāyāstu yasmādetāḥ prajajñirepaśum || (vi0 10|14) itivasudhādikalāprāntā bhogasādhanasaṃhatiḥparyaṭati karmavaśato bhuvanajahedeṣvayaṃ ca sarveṣu || (ślo0 24-25) itianyathā hi sukhādīnāṃ dṛṣṭo bhedo na yujyatesambandhādyugapat sā tu kurvantī karmakartṛbhiḥsūkṣmadehabhedo'vaśyamabhyupagantavyaḥātmanāmapyanekatvamata eva pratīyatevistareṇa darśitaḥkarmanirdeśavikṣobhakaraṇatvaṃ ca nottaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vikāritvādidharmyātmā virodhaśca śruteraṇaunāvyāpako na kṣaṇiko naiko nāpi jaḍātmakaḥ (vi0 6|7) iti catattvānāmapare skandhā bhogino ratibhūmayaḥsaṃsāriṇo bhogasthānānītyarthaḥnirayādistu satyāntā kālahāṭakadeśikaiḥśatarudravibhuścāpi saha pañcabhiraṣṭakaiḥkalāṃ tu maṇḍalinaḥ || itibuddhau ca kramaśo nyasetaprāptaguṇabhāve tu viśuddhe guṇamastakekrodheśvara(adi)rudrāṇāṃ purapaṅktiḥ pradhānagājagadbījaṃ mahāmāyā janyaśaktiracetanāanekābhirvicitrābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ śaktimatyasauacidvatāmanekatvād vināśitvaṃ suniścitamvyāpinī puruṣā'nantyād bhogāya kurute yataḥsarvātmanā pariṇāmameti, kintu ghṛtakīṭanyāyenaikadeśeneti mantavyamsargasthitilayāstasyāḥ svātmasaṃsthāḥ prakīrtitāḥbhogasādhanatayopādānamityavirodhaḥsargasthitī samākhyāte layaḥ sargaviparyayātsargaprātilomyena svasvakāraṇeṣūpasaṃhāra ityarthaḥpuṃsāṃ māyāmayaṃ bhogyaṃ māyotthaireva sādhanaiḥkiñcijjñatvāderapyadarśanātviṣayitvamalacchannasarvajñānakriyo yataḥśrīmatsvāyaṃbhuve- yadyaśuddhirnapuṃso'sti saktirbhogeṣu kiṃkṛtā (33|4) itibhavāntarakṛtaṃ karma jātyādiphaladaṃ nṛṇāmjanmādijanikā śaktiḥ karmaṇo na malaṃ vinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karmānuṣṭhānādarśanācca malayuktasyaiva karmārjanaṃ tadbhogo vā upayujyateviṣayitvaṃ hi tasyaikamastu kiṃ tena karmaṇāsanti kevalino jñānagrastāḥ karmavinākṛtāḥmāyāyoge heturityarthaḥprāksṛṣṭerniṣkalo janturdṛkkṛyāguṇavān yataḥkalāsambandhā'nyathā'nupapattyā tasya malo'bhyupagantavya ityarthaḥdṛkkriye sarvaviṣaye sarvagatvādaṇormatekalādivyañjakābhāvānna vyakte tasya dṛkkriyeanādyanādisambandho malaḥ sādhāraṇo'kṣayaḥata eva nityaśca malo'bhyupagantavyaḥmahāmohodbhavāt pūrvamaṇureṣa nirañjanaḥmalenātmano'nādisaṃbandho'bhyupagantavyaḥādimān yadi sambandha iṣṭaḥ puṃmalayorbudhāḥatha nirhetuko yogaḥ kalāyogo'pyahetukaḥanādyanādisambandho yadi ceṣṭo vinaśvaraḥpratipuṃniyatāścāsya śaktayo guṇarodhikāḥātmaguṇasya jñānakriyātmano rodhikāḥ | etacca prāgeva darśitamanyathā yugapanmuktiḥ sarveṣāṃ cidvatāṃ bhavetityādiśrīmatsvāyambhuvādiśruterāgantukā eva jñeyāḥvṛttayo viṣayitvasya madādyāḥ pañca nocitāḥtu malopādānatayetyavirodhaḥbhogasādhanasambandhād vyajyanta iti nocitambhavatā(ntu) guṇavṛttibhyo bhedenaiva madādayaḥtāmasau sāttvikaścaiva rājasau ca yathākramamābhyo bhinnā na mūlasya vṛttayo'to na santi tāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00005 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karmāśayasametasya hetutvaṃ ca bhaved bhaveyuktisiddham | nānyat kāryāntaramityarthaḥvicitrodārarūpāśca kleśā viṣayasaṅgināmprakaraṇāntare pradarśayiṣyata iti śubham
